1.consolidated_definition: Talla de un grupo de negros con una figura central en posición erecta, rodeada de siete figuras sentadas con los pies recogidos hacia el cuerpo y con los brazos cruzados frente a las piernas. Este sirve para rechazar todo mal.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Figure of a group of blacks with a central figure in an erect position, surrounded by seven seated figures with their legs drawn up towards the body and their arms crossed in front of their legs. This serves to repel all evil.
